title: Beyond Static Responses: Multi-Agent LLM Systems as a New Paradigm for Social Science Research

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual analysis of how LLMs trained on predominantly Western, Anglophone corpora underrepresent minority perspectives and reinforce dominant cultural norms in agentic simulations.

Conceptual evaluation of how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) smooths out controversial positions and homogenizes viewpoints, reducing the representational fidelity and real-world variance of simulated populations.

Review of multi-agent simulation studies that use specific prompts to activate confirmation bias in order to evaluate its effects on emergent social phenomena like ideological clustering, polarization, and opinion fragmentation.
